text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That time went straight into more customer conversations.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, searchable, and actually logged. Forecast reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Customers noticed.** Asking for consent upfront built trust. Transparency mattered more than the tool itself.

**4. Adoption wasn't automatic.** Reps who got a short template for reviewing summaries stuck with it. Those who didn't, drifted.

**5. Managers coached differently.** They could review real conversations instead of guessing.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It removed the busywork around it.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
